name: Hierarchical Scalar Field Sculpting
definition: A sculpting system where the user interacts with a tool modifying a scalar field. The interior of the sculpted object is represented by positive field values, and a null field where no material exists. The displayed surface evolves with a given iso-value, creating the illusion of direct interaction.
summary: Hierarchical Scalar Field Sculpting is an interactive 3D modeling method using an adaptive ntree grid with a fixed n=4 subdivision factor to locally refine scalar fields for high-resolution details without global performance costs.
